description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and three accuracy metrics: final accuracy, delta accuracy, and initial accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, with tick labels at 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, 0.98, and 0.99. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0.  A blue line representing "Final Acc" is plotted with circular markers and error bars; its value starts at approximately 0.83 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and decreases to 0.79 at an initial confidence of 0.99. An orange dashed line representing "Δ Acc" is plotted with diamond markers and error bars; it begins at around 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.95 and decreases to approximately 0.83 at an initial confidence of 0.99. A green dashed line representing "Initial Acc" is plotted with square markers and error bars; it starts at approximately 0.02 at a confidence of 0.95 and increases to 0.08 at a confidence of 0.99.
